XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure warning light on with drop in performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | TURBOCHARGER | TURBINE | TURBO | SUPERCHARGER | SMOKE | SMOKY | NOTICEABLE | SIGNIFICANTLY | ACCELERATION | WHEN ACCELERATING | AFTER | DECELERATION | CONSUMPTION | ABNORMAL | OIL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Turbocharger

  • Fault: The engine exhibits constant blue smoke, particularly intense during acceleration following a period of deceleration. The vehicle continues to run smoothly, but abnormal engine oil consumption has been detected.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty turbocharger

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the turbocharger and, if necessary, overhaul or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located centrally between the engine and the passenger compartment, approximately halfway up.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 3.5 hours.
